analysis_scope: Frozen source and authority only; no t01 outcome or mismatch detail was consulted.

expected_target_algorithm.frame_origin: positions[0] is the state after the first signed-speed plus PCG64 noise increment
expected_target_algorithm.stable_hidden_definition: first 19-frame consecutive run with world x in the inclusive interval [-4.09654256549771, 5.426536982279787]
expected_target_algorithm.tau_1_definition: the first frame of that fixed-world-x run
expected_target_algorithm.targets: tau 1 through 19 are onset through onset+18, inclusive
expected_target_algorithm.guard_role: entry and exit guards validate containment margins; they do not shift or discard hidden target frames

observed_target_algorithm.geometric_signal_used: the server_state.jsonl geometric_visible boolean emitted by the Fabric runtime
observed_target_algorithm.magenta_signal_used: the frozen HSV largest-valid-blob detector on each captured 640x360 PNG
observed_target_algorithm.tau_1_definition: the first captured model frame of that run; no already-stable hidden frames are discarded
observed_target_algorithm.guard_role: the contiguous disagreement/invalid run immediately before onset must not exceed the direction-specific entry guard

deterministic_alignment_trace.startspec_recording_origin: server tick 0, client render frame 0, action index 0, and model frame 0
deterministic_alignment_trace.warmup: 60 ticks occur before recording and are absent from all recorded frame identities
deterministic_alignment_trace.joins: server_tick, render_frame_idx, action_idx, and model_frame_idx are required to equal the same 0-based index
deterministic_alignment_trace.context: target frame t consumes the trailing inclusive window max(0,t-15)..t

prospective_divergence_points: The expected schedule substitutes a fixed empirical world-x interval for the live dual-visibility onset.
The expected schedule has no magenta-detector term and therefore cannot prospectively reproduce detector-dependent agreement transitions.

The production adapter consumes the Fabric server geometric_visible boolean, while visibility_authority.json identifies src/mineocclude/data/visibility.py and its four-way visible/occluded/boundary/invalid slab rule as the frozen geometric detector.
The Fabric boolean has no boundary/invalid representation, so boundary cases are coerced before dual classification.

Direction-specific guards validate different quantities in planning (distance from GEOMETRIC_ENTRY to fixed hidden onset) and observation (length of the immediately preceding disagreement/invalid run).
The A0 authority states that matched reverse-direction empirical wall crossing was not available and that bidirectional symmetry must not be assumed.
